_about: ColabFold-server MSAs (upstream --use_msa_server path, RBVI fork 2be3519 --msa_only, server https://api.colabfold.com, pairing greedy), fetched 2026-10-31 for the public PDB sequences of the macbench cases (tools/macbench/fetch_msa.sh). The csv files are not in the repository (9b3h_0.csv is 9.7 MB): tools/macbench/fetch_msa.sh fetches them into macbench-env/msa and tools/macbench/check_env.py --need msa compares them with these hashes (a fresh fetch can differ: the ColabFold databases change). rows = csv lines minus the header; paired = rows with a non-negative taxonomy key. 2026-11-02: nim_8eil / nim_7qsj / nim_8cpk / nim_8gpp (NIM-size cases, same path, RBVI fork --msa_only, 4.4-6.7 s each; public RCSB sequences only).
